αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; adj., fem. nom. sg.
αἰνὸς: αἰνός — fearsome, grim; adj., masc. nom. sg.
αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
αἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. pl. · also demonstrative ὁ, ἡ, τό (in Homer a pronoun), fem. nom. pl.: ’they’; αἳ μέν … αἳ δέ ’some … others’ · also fem. nom. pl. with a dual verb (a dual subject, two goddesses): ’the two’
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg.: ’of himself, him’ · also the adverb αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot’ · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of the speaker: ’of myself’ (ἐμὸν αὐτοῦ ’my own’) · also intensive gen. sg. after a possessive, of a third person: ’his own’ (ἑῷ αὐτοῦ θυμῷ ’his own heart’) · also masc. gen. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’of it’, ’upon it’ (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ ’upon it’) · also gen. sg. standing for a thing, partitive after τὸ μέν: ’of it’ (τὸ μὲν αὐτοῦ ’one part of it’) · also gen. sg. standing apart from its noun: ’his’ (διὰ δ’ αὐτοῦ … ὀδόντων ’through his teeth’) · also gen. sg., object of ἀπήμβροτε: ’him’ (αὐτοῦ ἀπήμβροτε ’missed him’) · also gen. sg. standing for a neuter thing: ’from it’ (ἐκ … αὐτοῦ ’from it’)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὐτῆμαρ: αὐτῆμαρ — on that very day; adv. (αὐτός + ἦμαρ)
αὐτῷ: αὐτός — self; masc. dat. sg., as a plain pronoun after a preposition: ’him’ (ἐπ’ αὐτῷ) · also intensive: ’himself’ · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with no preposition, indirect object: ’to him’ (ἥρμοσε … αὐτῷ ’fitted him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, with a verb of leaning: ’on it’ (αὐτῷ σκηπτόμενον ’leaning on it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun with ἔοικα: ’to him, like him’ (αὐτῷ … ἐῴκει ’resembled him’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a thing, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’with it’ (φρένες αὐτῷ ἕποντο ’the midriffs followed with it’) · also dat. sg. as a plain pronoun, of a person, of accompaniment with ἕπομαι, no preposition: ’him’ (ἕπετ’ αὐτῷ ’followed him’)
αὐχένα: αὐχήν — neck; masc. acc. sg., object of ἐξ … ἄξῃ (tmesis): ’breaks the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of βάλλω: ’hit the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of τύπτε: ’struck the neck’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of ἔλασσεν: ’struck the neck’ (αὐχένα μέσσον ἔλασσεν ’struck the neck in the middle’)
αὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; pres. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’speak!’
αὖτις: αὖτις — back, again, once more; adv. (= αὖθις)
βάλλε: βάλλω — throw, cast; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔβαλλε)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ’good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός)
βῆ: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔβη): ’went, strode’
γέντο: γέντο — took, grasped (= ἕλετο); defective aor. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented, epic, with no present in use
γέρας: γέρας — prize of honour, privilege, due portion; neut. nom./acc. sg.
γέροντες: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. nom. pl.
γήραϊ: γῆρας — old age; neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic γήρᾳ), dative of cause: ’by old age’ · also dat. after ἐπιτρέπω: ’(yield) to old age’
γαῖαν: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. acc. sg.
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γουνῷ: γουνός — rising ground or fertile plot (sense uncertain); masc. dat. sg.
γούναθ: γόνυ (pl. γούνατα) — knee; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (γούναθ’ = γούνατα)
γυναῖκες: γυνή — woman, wife; fem. nom. pl.: ’women’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δάκρυ: δάκρυ — tear, tears; neut. acc. sg., object of χέω: ’shedding tears’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a tear’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἀπομόρξατο ’wiped away’
δάμασσεν: δαμάζω — subdue, overpower, tame; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-, unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐδάμασε)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δή: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; masc. dat. sg.
δίκην: δίκη — justice, right; fem. acc. sg.: ’justice’
δαίδαλα: δαίδαλον — intricate work, finely wrought thing; neut. acc. pl.
δαμείς: δάμνημι (δαμάζω) — overpower, subdue; aor. pass. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’overcome’
δοκεύει: δοκεύω — watch for, watch closely; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’watches’
δυσηχέος: δυσηχής — grim-sounding, dreadful in noise; adj. of two endings, masc. gen. sg., epic -έος (= Attic -οῦς), agreeing with πολέμοιο
δόμεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. inf., epic -μεν (= Attic δοῦναι)
δόμον: δόμος — house, home; masc. acc. sg.
δύναμαι: δύναμαι — be able, can; pres. 1 sg. mid./pass. dep., + inf.: ’I am able’
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable · also δύω — go into, put on (armour); aor. subj. 1 sg. act., short-vowel subj. after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’I put on’ (τεύχεα δύω)
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῦ: δύω — go into, sink, enter; aor. 3 sg., root aorist, unaugmented (= Attic ἔδυ): ’sank in’
δῶ: δῶ — house, home; indeclinable epic noun (= δῶμα), acc. sg., goal of motion after ποτί · also without a preposition, acc. of the goal after ἱκάνω: ’to the house’
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἔδωκε)
δῶρ: δῶρον — gift; neut. acc. pl., elided (δῶρ’ = δῶρα) · also neut. nom. pl., elided: ’gifts’ (δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’the gifts of Aphrodite’)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also ’whether’, introducing an indirect question · εἰ δή ’if indeed, since’ · also εἰ δ’ ἄγε ’come now’, a hortatory idiom · also εἰ γάρ + opt., introducing a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ γὰρ … εἴην ’if only I were’) · also εἰ γὰρ δή + indic.: ’if indeed’ (εἰ γὰρ δὴ μέματον ’if you two are indeed eager’)
εἰν: ἐν (epic εἰν) — in, among; prep. + dat.
εἰπὼν: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.
εἰσ: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 pl., elided (εἰσ’ = εἰσί): ’are’
εἴποι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. opt. 3 sg.
εἴσω: εἴσω — within, inside; adv. · also adv. with a gen., as a preposition: ’into’ (Ἄϊδος εἴσω ’into (the house of) Hades’) · also postpositive, with an acc., ’into’ (οὐρανὸν εἴσω ’into heaven’)
εἵατ: ἧμαι — sit; pres. 3 pl., epic εἵαται (= Attic κάθηνται), elided (εἵατ’ = εἵαται): ’sit’ · also impf. 3 pl., elided (εἵατ’ = εἵατο, = Attic ἧντο): ’sat’
εἵνεκα: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., often after its noun; epic prothetic ε- (εἵνεκα)
εὐνὴν: εὐνή — bed, marriage-bed; fem. acc. sg.
εὔχετο: εὔχομαι — pray, vow; impf. 3 sg.: ’was praying’ (no augment written; εὐ- not lengthened to ηὐ-)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
ζώει: ζώω (Attic ζάω) — live, be alive; pres. 3 sg.
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θάρσει: θαρσέω — be of good courage, take heart; pres. imper. 2 sg. (= Attic θάρρει) · also θάρσος — courage, boldness; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic θάρσει), dat. of cause: ’in your boldness’
θέτι: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. voc. sg., in address · also fem. dat. sg.: ’to Thetis’
θέτις: Θέτις — Thetis, sea-goddess, mother of Achilles; fem. nom. sg.
θαμίζεις: θαμίζω — come often, be a frequent visitor; pres. 2 sg. act.
θανάτοιο: θάνατος — death; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεαί: θεά — goddess; fem. nom. pl., predicate: ’goddesses’
θρέψασα: τρέφω — rear, nourish; aor. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’having reared’
θρόνου: θρόνος — chair, seat; masc. gen. sg.
θυμὸν: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; acc. sg. · also the life that leaves the body: ’life’ (θυμὸν ὀλέσσῃ ’lose his life’) · also acc. of respect: ’in heart’ (θυμὸν ἐχώσατο ’was angered in heart’)
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
θῆκεν: τίθημι — put, place, make; aor. 3 sg., with ν-movable (= θῆκε), with double acc.: ’made (him) conspicuous’ · also ’laid, set’, with acc. and ἐπί + dat.: ’laid it on the knees’
κ: κε(ν) (elided κ’) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν) · also εἰ … κ’ + subj. in a condition: ’if … should’ · also ἐπεί κ’ + aor. subj., prospective temporal: ’when, once’ · also εἰς ὅ κ’ + opt., ’until … should’ · also κ’ + opt., potential: ’would’ (οὐδέ κ’ … ὀνόσαιτ’ ’nor would … make light of’) · also εἴ … κ’ + fut. indic. in a condition: ’if … shall’ (εἴ κ’ … ἑλκήσουσιν ’if … drag’)
κήδεα: κῆδος — care, trouble, sorrow; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδη)
κακὰ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl. as a noun: ’evils’ · also neut. acc. pl., adj. with ἔργα: ’evil (deeds)’
καλάς: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. acc. pl., agreeing with κνημῖδας
καλέουσιν: καλέω — call, summon; pres. 3 pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic καλοῦσι(ν))
καλὰ: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. acc. pl. as an adverb, with a negative: ’not well’ (οὐ … καλὰ ’not fairly’) · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔντεα: ’fine (gear)’
καλὰς: καλός — beautiful, fair, fine; fem. acc. pl.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’ · also + acc. of the place struck: ’in, on’ (κατὰ δεξιὸν ὦμον ’in the right shoulder’) · also + acc., ’into, toward’ (κατὰ πληθὺν ’toward the throng’) · also + acc., ’according to, after’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’after one’s heart’) · also κατὰ ἶσα ’equally, evenly’ (κατὰ ἶσα μάχην ἐτάνυσσε) · also + acc. of the part of a weapon: ’at’ (κατὰ στόμα ’at the tip’) · also + acc., ’through, out along’ (κατὰ ῥῖνας ’out through the nostrils’) · also + gen., ’down into’ (κατὰ γαίης ’down into the earth’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after εἰς ὅ: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … μάχωνται ’until they fight’) · also εἴ κεν + opt., in a condition: ’if … should’ · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὥς: ’so that … may’ · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὅτε: ’whenever’ (ὅτε κεν … ἵκωμαι ’whenever I come’) · also ἤ κεν + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὅππως κεν + subj., in an indirect question: ’how … may’ · also ὄφρά κεν + subj., purpose: ’so that … may’ (ὄφρά κεν ἔλθητον ’so that you two may come’) · also + subj. in a temporal clause after ὄφρ’ ἂν: ’as long as’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν ὁρᾷ ’as long as he sees’) · also ἐπεί κεν + fut. indic., in a temporal clause: ’as soon as’ (ἐπεί κεν … παραλέξομαι ’as soon as I shall lie beside’)
κεῖται: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; pres. 3 sg.: ’lies’
κεῖτο: κεῖμαι — lie, be laid; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκειτο): ’lay’, also with a neut. pl. subject (ἅρματα κεῖτο ’the chariots lay’)
κηρύκων: κῆρυξ — herald; masc. gen. pl., partitive: ’of the heralds’
κνημῖδας: κνημίς — greave, leg-guard; fem. acc. pl.
κνῆμαι: κνήμη — shin, lower leg; fem. nom. pl.
κορωνίσιν: κορωνίς — curved, with a curved stern (of ships); fem. dat. pl., epic -ισιν, agreeing with νηυσί
κούρην: κούρη — girl, daughter (epic = Attic κόρη); fem. acc. sg.
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κρονίδης: Κρονίδης — son of Cronus (Zeus); masc. nom. sg., patronymic
κῦδος: κῦδος — glory, the lustre of success granted by a god; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., in apposition: ’glory’
λίπεν: λείπω — leave, quit; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλιπε)
λίσσοντο: λίσσομαι — beg, entreat; impf. 3 pl. mid. deponent: ’begged’
λαμπομενάων: λάμπομαι (= λάμπω) — shine, flare, blaze; pres. part. mid. fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν)
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host; masc. nom. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς, pl. λεῴ)
λαὸν: λαός — people, host; masc. acc. sg.
λοιγὸν: λοιγός — ruin, destruction, havoc; masc. acc. sg.
λυγρὰ: λυγρός — grievous, baneful, miserable; neut. acc. pl.: ’grievous things’
λυγρῷ: λυγρός — baneful, bitter, grievous; masc./neut. dat. sg., with γήραϊ: ’grievous (old age)’ · also masc./neut. dat. sg., with ἕλκεϊ: ’grievous (wound)’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.) · also = dat. μοι, elided, with a dat. adjective: ’to me’ (μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε ’defend me alone’)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, by all means; adv.
μάρναντο: μάρναμαι — fight; impf. 3 pl. mid., unaugmented (= ἐμάρναντο): ’fought’
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big; masc. acc. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’) · also μένω — stay, stand firm; pres. imper. 2 sg., elided (μέν’ = μένε): ’stand!’ (ἠὲ μέν’ ’either stand’)
μέσσοισι: μέσος — middle, mid; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι with double σ (= Attic μέσοις); ἐν μέσσοισι ’in the midst’
μή: μή — not; the negative of wish, command, fear and condition (where οὐ is the negative of fact) · also ’lest’, with the subj. · also ’lest’ with the opt. (μή … δευοίατο ’lest they lack’) · also ’lest’ with a dual verb in -ετον: ’lest the two … hang back’ · also the negative of an infinitive in an oath: ’never to’ (μή ποτε … ἐπιβήμεναι)
μαρμαρέην: μαρμάρεος — gleaming, shimmering; fem. acc. sg., epic -έην (= Attic -έαν), agreeing with ἅλα
μαχησόμενον: μάχομαι — fight (epic μαχέομαι); fut. part. mid. masc. acc. sg., of purpose: ’to fight’
μεγάροις: μέγαρον — hall, great room; neut. dat. pl.: ’in the halls’
μενοιτίου: Μενοίτιος — Menoetius, father of Patroclus; masc. gen. sg.
μερόπων: μέροψ — epithet of men, ’mortal’ or ’speech-dividing’ (meaning uncertain); masc. gen. pl.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis · also + acc. in μετὰ νῶτα βαλών: ’behind, with the back turned’ · also + acc. of direction: ’to, back to’ (μετὰ νῆας ’to the ships’)
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’ · also dat. of possession or interest: ’my’ (μοι ἵπποι ’my horses’)
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative in wishes, prohibitions and purpose clauses (’lest, that not’) · also in a conditional clause + subj.: ’if not’ · also in a conditional clause + opt.: εἰ μὴ … μνησαίαθ’ ’unless … were to call to mind’ · also εἰ μὴ with an aor. indic., past unreal condition: ’had not’ (εἰ μὴ … ἐξήγγειλεν ’had not … told’) · also μὴ μέν + fut. indic., introducing the content of an oath: ’that … not’ (μὴ μὲν … ἐποχήσεται ’that no other man will ride’) · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’) · also the negative of an infinitive in a reported threat: ’not to’ (μὴ πρίν … ἀπονέεσθαι ’not to go back until’) · also μή + pres. indic. after an oath, introducing its content: ’that … not’ (μὴ … πημαίνει ’that he does not harm’) · also the negative of an infinitive used as a command: ’and not to’ (μὴ δὲ … εἶναι ’and do not be’)
νεῖκος: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. nom. sg., subject: ’a quarrel (has arisen)’ · also neut. acc. sg., object of ἔμβαλε: ’threw a quarrel’
νηυσὶν: ναῦς — ship; fem. dat. pl., epic νηυσί(ν)
νοστήσαντα: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. masc. acc. sg.: ’having returned’
νόος: νόος — mind, purpose; masc. nom. sg. (= Attic νοῦς)
νόσφιν: νόσφιν — apart, far off, away; adv. · also prep. + gen.: ’apart from, without’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἱ ἄριστοι ’the best men’) · also enclitic dat. sg. pron. for a thing: ’on it, to it’ (ἐν δέ οἱ ἧλοι ’and on it studs’)
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’ · also masc. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (οἳ θάμνοι ’the bushes’) · also masc. nom. pl. in the correlative οἳ μὲν … οἳ δέ: ’some … others’
οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg., epic οἴη (= Attic μόνη): ’you alone’
οἴκαδε: οἴκαδε — homeward, to one’s home; adv., οἶκος + directional suffix -δε
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὐρανόν: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. acc. sg.
οὐρανὸς: οὐρανός — sky, heaven; masc. nom. sg.
οὐχ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a rough breathing (οὐχ) · also in a question expecting ’yes’ (ἦ οὐχ ἅλις ὅττι … ; ’is it not enough that …?’)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντ: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl., elided (πάντ’ = πάντα)
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. pl.: ’all (things)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a name: ’all (through the whole of)’ (Αἰγιαλόν τ’ ἀνὰ πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. adverbially: ’in every respect, in all things’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ταῦτα: ’all’ (ταῦτα … πάντα ’all these things’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα: ’all (the flesh)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject, agreeing with ἄλλα: ’all else’ (ἄλλά τε πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἤματα: ’all (days)’ (ἤματα πάντα ’all days’)
πάντοσε: πάντοσε — in every direction, all round; adv.
πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv.: ’once before’, with a finite verb · also with a participle: ’already, from before’ (πάρος μεμαυῖαν ’already eager’) · also correlative with πρίν, ’before (that)’ (πάρος … πρίν ’not … until’) · also + inf.: ’before’ (πάρος … γενέσθαι ’before … came to be’) · also adv. of anticipation: ’first, sooner’ (πάρος … δώσω ’I will give first’) · also prep. + gen.: ’before’ (Τυδεΐδαο πάρος ’before the son of Tydeus’) · also τὸ πάρος, adverbial: ’as before’ (ὡς τὸ πάρος περ) · also with a future, ’first, before that’ (πάρος … καθέξει ’first … will hold’)
πάτροκλον: Πάτροκλος — Patroclus, Achilles’ closest companion; masc. acc. sg.
πέμπε: πέμπω — send, send off; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔπεμπε): ’sent, was sending’
πέντε: πέντε — five; numeral, indeclinable, agreeing with κασιγνήτῃσιν
παρέσσεται: πάρειμι — be at hand, be present; fut. 3 sg., epic doubled σ (= Attic παρέσται): ’will be at hand’
πασέων: πᾶς — all, every; fem. gen. pl. πασέων, epic (= Attic πασῶν)
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
περικλυτὰ: περικλυτός — very famous, renowned; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα · also neut. acc. pl., agreeing with δῶρα: ’very famous (gifts)’
περικλυτὸς: περικλυτός — very famous, far-famed; masc. nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form), epithet of Hephaestus
περὶ: περί — around; + gen.: ’beyond, above’, or adv. ’exceedingly’ · also preverb in tmesis ’all round’ · also adv. in tmesis with εἰμί: ’surpass’ (περὶ … ἐστέ) · also + dat. of place: ’around’ (περὶ δουρί ’around the spear’) · also with ἀμφί, both before an accusative, ’round about’ (ἀμφὶ περὶ κρήνην ’round about a spring’) · also prep. + acc. of place: ’around’ (περὶ Δωδώνην ’around Dodona’) · also + gen., ’about, for the sake of’ (μαχήσονται περὶ σεῖο ’will fight about you’) · also adv. ’around, about’ (περὶ … ἦσαν ’were around’) · also adv., ’round about, on every side’ (περὶ κτείνοντο ’were killed all around’) · also adv. ’beyond others’ with the dat. of respect: ’by far’ (περὶ ἔγχει … φέρτατος ’best by far with the spear’) · also prep. + dat., of concern: ’for, over’ (περὶ ξανθῷ Μενελάῳ ’for fair-haired Menelaus’) · also prep. + acc. of the thing contended for: ’over’ (περὶ τεύχε’ ’over the armour’)
πεῖραρ: πεῖραρ — end, limit; also rope, bond (which is meant in a given passage is often disputed); neut. nom./acc. sg.
πηλήϊον: Πηλήϊος — of Peleus, Peleus’; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic Πηλήϊος (= Attic Πηλεῖος), agreeing with δόμον
πηλῆϊ: Πηλεύς — Peleus, father of Achilles; masc. dat. sg., epic Πηλῆϊ (= Attic Πηλεῖ): ’to Peleus’
πιστὸς: πιστός — trusty, faithful; adj., masc. nom. sg., agreeing with ἑταῖρος
πιφαύσκων: πιφαύσκω — make known, signal, declare; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg., reduplicated, epic, + dat.: ’making known’
πλησίον: πλησίος — near, neighbouring; neut. acc. sg. as adv. πλησίον: ’near, beside’; ἐς πλησίον ἄλλον ’to another next to him’
ποινῆς: ποινή — requital, payment exacted for a killing or wrong; fem. gen. sg., after εἵνεκα: ’for the requital’
πολέων: πολύς — much, many; masc. gen. pl., uncontracted epic πολέων (= Attic πολλῶν): ’of many’
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.; also adverbial, ’much, earnestly’ · also neut. nom. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’many (works)’
πολὺν: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with λαόν: ’a great host’ · also masc. acc. sg. agreeing with χρόνον: ’a long (time)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὅμιλον: ’a great (throng)’ (πολὺν καθ’ ὅμιλον ’through the great throng’) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with πόνον: ’much (toil)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄμβρον: ’a great (rain)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κολοσυρτόν: ’a great (uproar)’
πολὺς: πολύς — much, many, great; masc. nom. sg., grave accent mid-clause (πολὺς ὀρυμαγδός ’a great din’)
προμάχοισι: πρόμαχος — front-fighter, champion; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
πρύμνῃσιν: πρύμνη — stern of a ship; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις): ’sterns’
πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
πυρός: πῦρ — fire; neut. gen. sg., partitive: ’a share of fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., with μαλεροῦ, of the means after ἐμπρήσειν: ’with devouring fire’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on αὐγῇ: ’of the fire’ (ἐν πυρὸς αὐγῇ ’in the glare of the fire’)
πόλεις: πόλις — city; fem. acc. pl. (in apposition to the place-names) · also fem. acc. pl., direct object of a verb of sacking: ’cities’
πόλεμον: πόλεμος — war, battle; masc. acc. sg.
πύλῃσι: πύλη — gate; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic πύλαις)
πᾶν: πᾶς — all, every; neut. acc. sg., attributive: ’every, the whole’ · also neut. nom. sg. (same form), attributive with a subject: ’the whole’ (πᾶν ξίφος ’the whole sword’)
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl., with πύλαι · also fem. nom. pl. with another fem. noun: ’all’ (πᾶσαι χολάδες ’all the bowels’) · also fem. nom. pl., in apposition to a pronoun: ’all (of them)’ (αἳ … πᾶσαι ’they all’) · also fem. nom. pl. agreeing with feminine town-names: ’all (the towns)’
σάκεος: σάκος — shield; neut. gen. sg., epic -εος (= Attic -ους)
σάκος: σάκος — shield; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’the shield’ (σάκος … ἀνεδέξατο ’the shield received’)
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σκαιῇσι: σκαιός — left, left-hand; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇσι (= Attic σκαιαῖς): Σκαιῇσι πύλῃσι ’at the Scaean Gates’ (the sense of the name is uncertain)
σκῆπτρα: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre; neut. acc. pl.
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
στήθεα: στῆθος — chest, breast; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic στήθη)
στιβαρόν: στιβαρός — stout, massive, sturdy; neut. nom./acc. sg.
στιβαρὸν: στιβαρός — stout, strong, solid; masc. acc. sg. and neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’sturdy’
στρέφεται: στρέφω — turn, wheel round; pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’wheels about, turns’
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (gifts)’
σῇσι: σός — your (sg.); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αῖς)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’ · also epic τε attached to ἦ, strengthening it: ἦ τ’ ’truly indeed’ · also τε in ἤ τ’ … ἤ τ’, ’either … or’ (ἤ τ’ ἔβλητ’ ἤ τ’ ἔβαλ’ ’either is hit or hits’)
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’) · also relative, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ (τά οἵ ποτε … πόρε ’which he once gave him’)
τάλαντα: τάλαντον — scales, balance (also a weight, a talent); neut. acc. pl., the plural for a pair of scales · also neut. acc. pl., talents, a weight of gold: ’talents’
τί: τίς, τι — anyone, anything; indefinite enclitic, accented τί before an enclitic; neut. acc. sg. adverbial: ’at all, in any way’ · also interrogative τίς, τί: ’what? why?’ (τί κλαίεις ’why are you weeping?’) · also neut. nom. sg. agreeing with ἔγχος after εἴ: ’any’ (εἴ τί τοι ἔγχος ’if any spear of yours’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κῆδος after εἴ: ’some’ (εἴ πέρ τί σε κῆδος ἱκάνει ’if some concern reaches you’)
τίθει: τίθημι — put, place, set; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίθει) · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’put, give!’
τίπτε: τίπτε — why ever, what then (= τί ποτε shortened); interrog. adv.
τανύπεπλε: τανύπεπλος — with long, trailing robe; adj., fem. voc. sg., in address
ταῦτα: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τελέσαι: τελέω — accomplish, bring to pass, fulfill; aor. inf.: ’to bring to pass’
τελαμῶνα: τελαμών — broad strap, belt, baldric; masc. acc. sg.
τετελεσμένον: τελέω — bring to pass, fulfil; perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἔσται: ’shall stand fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἦεν: ’would have been fulfilled’ · also perf. pass. part. neut. nom. sg., periphrastic with ἐστίν: ’is a thing to be fulfilled’
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’armour’
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. nom./acc. sg. · in ὅ τι, ’whatever, why’ (= ὅτι) · also adverbial acc. with οὐ: ’at all’ (οὔ τι δυνήσεαι ’you will not at all be able’) · also adverbial acc. after εἰ: ’at all’ (εἴ ποτε δή τι … ὤνησας ’if ever you helped at all’) · also neut. acc. sg. with κακόν after μή: ’some’ (μή τι … ῥέξῃ κακὸν ’lest he do some evil’) · also adverbial acc. after μή: ’at all’ (μή τι διατρίβειν ’not to delay at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object of πάσχω after μή: ’any (harm)’ (μή τι πάθοι ’lest he suffer any harm’) · also adverbial acc. after αἴ κεν: ’somehow’ (αἴ κέν τι … γένηαι ’if somehow you become’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with a partitive gen.: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τῶν μέμνηται ’nor does he remember any of it’) · also adverbial acc. after οὐδέ, with no partitive: ’at all’ (οὐδέ τι τίει ’does not honour at all’) · also neut. sg., agreeing with μῆχος after οὐδέ: ’any’ (οὐδέ τι μῆχος ’nor any means’) · also adverbial acc. after μήτε: ’at all’ (μήτέ τι νείκει ’nor find fault at all’) · also adverbial acc. with a comparative: ’somewhat’ (τι … ἄμεινον ’somewhat better’) · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with σπέος: ’a certain’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with ὄφελος: ’some’ (ὄφελός τι ’some use’) · also adverbial acc. in a question after ἠέ: ’at all’ (ἠέ τι βέβληαι ’have you been hit at all’) · also neut. acc. sg., object after εἰ: ’anything’ (εἴ τι … ῥέξει ’if … will do anything’)
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also with a negative: ’any, anyone’ (οὐ … τις ’no one’; οὐδέ τις ’nor any’) · also after the relative ὅς, indefinite: ὅς τις ’whichever, whoever’ · also after ὅς, as an indirect interrogative: ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’ · also after εἰ: ’if anyone’ (εἴ τις …) · also after μή: ’lest any’ (μή τις Δαναῶν ’lest any of the Danaans’)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὔνεκα: τοὔνεκα (crasis of τοῦ ἕνεκα) — for this reason, therefore; adv.
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl.: ’to the others’ (τοῖς ἄλλοις) · also masc. dat. pl., ’to them’ (τοῖς … μύθων ἦρχε ’led the talk before them’) · also masc. dat. pl. with a noun, demonstrative: ’these’ (τοῖς ἵπποισιν ’these horses’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl., + ἐπεποίθει: ’in whom’ (τοῖς ἐπεποίθει ’whom he trusted’)
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’) · also relative, masc. dat. pl.: ’against whom’ (τοῖσιν κότον ἔθεσθε ’against whom you conceived resentment’)
τραφέμεν: τρέφω — rear, nourish; intr. aor. inf. τραφέμεν, epic -έμεν (= Attic τραφῆναι): ’to grow up, be reared’
τρωσὶ: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τρῶες: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’Trojans!’
τό: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg. ’it, that’, often with γε: ’that at least’ · also neut. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’) · also relative, neut. acc. sg., inner object: ’which’ (ἕλκος τό μιν βάλε ’the wound with which he struck him’) · also neut. acc. sg. adverbial, ’on that account’ (τό γε δείδιθι ’fear not on that account’) · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (βῶν ἀζαλέην, τό μοι ἔστι … ’the dry hide, which is mine to …’)
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl. · τὰ πρῶτα ’at first’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. acc. pl.: ’which’ · also neut. acc. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τὰ σ’ αὐτῆς ἔργα ’your own tasks’)
τὰς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl. as a relative, ’which’ (τὰς Εὔμηλος ἔλαυνε ’which Eumelus drove’) · also fem. acc. pl. demonstrative: ’these, them’ (τὰς διαπέρσαι ’to sack these’)
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’) · also fem. acc. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’ · also masc. acc. sg. standing for a masculine thing: ’it’ (τὸν δῶκε ’gave it’) · also masc. acc. sg., in the correlative τὸν μέν … τὸν δέ: ’the one … the other’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ · also fem. gen. sg. ’for her’, gen. of cause after ἀχέων (τῆς … ἀχέων ’grieving for her’) · also fem. gen. sg., of the person heard after ἔκλυεν: ’her’ · also fem. gen. sg. with a noun, demonstrative: ’that’ (φιλότητος … τῆς ’that friendship’)
τῇ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; fem. dat. sg. · with an ordinal, ’on the (day)’: τῇ δεκάτῃ ’on the tenth’ · also adverbial, ’by that way, there’ · also fem. dat. sg. as relative adverb: ’by which way’ (τῇ … ἔμελλε διεξίμεναι ’by which he was about to go out’) · also fem. dat. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, my’ (τῇ ἐμῇ κλισίῃ ’my hut’) · also relative adverb: ’where’ (τῇ ῥα μάλιστα ’where especially’) · also fem. dat. sg. with the postpositive ὕπο: ’beneath it’ (τῇ ὕπο) · also relative, fem. dat. sg., of means: ’with which’ (τῇ … ἐπισσείων ’shaking which’) · also fem. dat. sg. demonstrative, with ἐνί: ’by it’ (of a shield-rim, τῇ … ἐνὶ βλαφθεὶς ’hindered by it’)
τῇς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. dat. pl., epic τῇς (= Attic ταῖς): relative ’to whom’ · also demonstrative, ’to them’ (of gates, ἐπὶ τῇς ἀραρυῖαι ’fitted to them’)
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’) · also instrumental, ’with it’ (τῷ … τύψε ’struck with it’) · also relative, instrumental: ’with which’ · also causal/instrumental, ’by it’ (τῷ τείρετο ’was worn by it’) · also with ἅμα, of company: ’with him’ (τῷ … ἅμ’ ’along with him’) · also neut. dat. sg., ’in it’ (ἐν τῷ … κύκησε ’in it mixed’, of a cup) · also masc. dat. sg. with a participle: ’upon him (as he drew)’ (ἐπὶ τῷ ἐρύοντι)
υἱεῖ: υἱός — son; masc. dat. sg., epic by-form (= Attic υἱῷ)
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάος: φάος — light (epic uncontracted = Attic φῶς); neut. nom./acc. sg.
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also fem. voc. sg., in address: ’dear (bride)’
φαεινοῦ: φαεινός — shining, bright; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with πέπλοιο · also neut. gen. sg., agreeing with δουρός: ’shining (spear)’ (φαεινοῦ δουρός)
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
φρένας: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. acc. pl.
φρεσίν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶ: φρήν — mind, heart, wits; fem. dat. pl.
φρεσὶν: φρήν — mind, heart, wits (lit. midriff); fem. dat. pl.
φρονέεις: φρονέω — think, have in mind, intend; pres. 2 sg. act., epic uncontracted (= Attic φρονεῖς)
φυτὸν: φυτόν — plant, growing thing; neut. acc. sg., in apposition to τόν: ’a (young) plant’
φῦ: φύω — grow, put forth; aor. 3 sg. root aorist, unaugmented (= ἔφυ), intransitive; ἔν … φῦ in tmesis (= ἐνέφυ): ’clung to’
χέουσα: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. act. fem. nom. sg.: ’pouring, shedding’
χέρσ: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., epic by-form χέρσι, elided (χέρσ’ = χέρσι, Attic χερσί): ’by the hands’
χαλκὸν: χαλκός — bronze; masc. acc. sg.: ’the bronze’ (i.e. armour) · also the bronze weapon, the spear-point: ’the bronze’ (χαλκὸν ἀνασχέσθαι ’to withstand the bronze’)
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; fem. gen. pl., dependent on a noun: μένος χειρῶν ’the might of hands’ · also fem. gen. pl., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the hands’ (ἐκ … χειρῶν ’out of the hands’) · also fem. gen. pl., object of ἅπτομαι (gen. of the part touched): χειρῶν ἁψάσθην ’took hold of his hands’ · also fem. gen. pl. of separation after ἀπό: ’from the hands’ (θρασειάων ἀπὸ χειρῶν ’from the bold hands’)
χεῖρ: χείρ — hand; fem. acc. sg., elided (χεῖρ’ = χεῖρα)
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
χραισμῆσαι: χραισμέω — ward off, avail, help (+ dat.); aor. inf. act.: ’to ward off’
χρυσοῖο: χρυσός — gold; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
χρύσειαι: χρύσεος — golden; fem. nom. pl., epic (= Attic χρυσαῖ)
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
ἀθανάτων: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; gen. pl., as a noun, partitive: ’of the immortals’ · also adj., gen. pl. agreeing with a noun: ’immortal’ (ἀθανάτων … θεῶν ’of the immortal gods’)
ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκάμαντα: Ἀκάμας, -αντος — Acamas, a Trojan warrior; masc. acc. sg. · also ἀκάμας, -αντος — untiring, tireless; adj., masc. acc. sg., agreeing with σῦν: ’tireless’
ἀλωῆς: ἀλωή — orchard, vineyard, cultivated plot; fem. gen. sg.
ἀμφίπολοι: ἀμφίπολος — handmaid, attendant; fem. nom. pl.
ἀμφιγυήεις: ἀμφιγυήεις — epithet of Hephaestus, conventionally ’lame in both legs’ or ’strong in both arms’; sense disputed; masc. nom. sg.
ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both (of two); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), after μετά: ’among both’ · also dat. of interest: ’for both’
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀμῦναι: ἀμύνω — ward off, defend; aor. inf. act.; ἀπὸ … ἀμῦναι ’ward off from’
ἀνέδραμεν: ἀνατρέχω — run up; strong aor. 3 sg. (stem δραμ-), ν-movable: ’ran up’
ἀνέρος: ἀνήρ — man; masc. gen. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀνδρός)
ἀνέστη: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; aor. 3 sg. intrans.: ’stood up’
ἀνέσχετο: ἀνέχω — hold up, raise (mid. ἀνέχομαι also endure); aor. 3 sg. mid., augmented after the preverb: ’held up, raised’
ἀναίνετο: ἀναίνομαι — refuse, reject, disdain; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἠναίνετο): ’refused’
ἀνθρώπων: ἄνθρωπος — human being, man; masc. gen. pl.
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’ · also with σχέο in tmesis: ’back, up’ (ἀνὰ … σχέο = ἀνάσχεο ’hold back’) · also with ἀείραι in tmesis: ’up’ (ἀνὰ … ἀείραι ’raise up’) · also + acc. of place: ’up on’ (ἀνὰ μυρίκην ’up on a tamarisk’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ θυμόν: ’in the heart, in the mind’
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen. · also a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀπ’ … ὀμόργνυ = ἀπομόργνυ ’wiped off’) · also with a form in -φιν: ’from’ (ἀπ’ αὐτόφιν ’from it’)
ἀπάνευθε: ἀπάνευθε — far away, apart, at a distance; adv., + gen.
ἀποδοῦναι: ἀποδίδωμι — give back, give up; aor. inf. act.
ἀπομόργνυ: ἀπομόργνυμι — wipe off; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= ἀπεμόργνυ): ’wiped away, was wiping off’
ἀπώλεσε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.: ’destroyed’
ἀραρυίας: ἀραρίσκω — fit together; perf. part. fem. acc. pl., epic reduplicated -υῖα, no Attic prose equivalent: ’fitted’
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, of silver; adj., neut. nom. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν), agreeing with a neuter noun
ἀρωγοί: ἀρωγός — helper, helping; masc. nom. pl., as a noun: ’helpers’
ἀτειρέα: ἀτειρής — unwearing, hard, unbreakable; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀτειρῆ)
ἀχέων: ἀχέω — grieve, mourn; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (cf. ἄχνυμαι): ’grieving’
ἀχαιοὺς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀχεύων: ἀχεύω — grieve, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic by-form of ἀχέω: ’grieving’
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; neut. acc. pl.: ’his own’ (τὰ ἃ φρονέων ’thinking his own thoughts’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (ἃ … τετελεσμένα ἦεν ’things that had been fulfilled’)
ἄλγε: ἄλγος — pain, grief; neut. nom./acc. pl. (ἄλγεα, elided ἄλγε’)
ἄλκιμον: ἄλκιμος — strong in defence, staunch (from ἀλκή); neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with υἱόν: ’valiant’
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. pl.: ’the other (things)’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’some’ (ἄλλα μὲν … πολλὰ δὲ ’some … many’)
ἄλλοτε: ἄλλοτε — at another time, at one time … at another; adv.
ἄμαξαν: ἄμαξα — wagon, cart; fem. acc. sg.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄνακτι: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. dat. sg.
ἄνακτος: ἄναξ — lord, king, master; masc. gen. sg.
ἄνωγεν: ἄνωγα — order, bid; perf. with present force, 3 sg. ἄνωγεν also in past sense (= ἠνώγει): ’ordered’
ἄπο: ἀπό — from, away from; prep. + gen., accented ἄπο when it follows its noun (νεῶν ἄπο ’from the ships’) · also adv. or preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb: ’off’ (ἄπο … νίζοντες ’washing off’)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, then, as it turned out; inferential particle
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἄχνυται: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, be distressed; pres. 3 sg. mid./dep.: ’grieves’
ἅμα: ἅμα — together, at the same time; adv. · also prep. + dat.: ’together with’
ἐείκοσι: εἴκοσι — twenty; numeral, indeclinable, epic prothetic ἐ- (ἐείκοσι = εἴκοσι)
ἐθέλουσα: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’wishing, willing’
ἐθέλῃσθα: ἐθέλω — be willing, wish; pres. subj. 2 sg., epic ending -ῃσθα (= Attic ἐθέλῃς)
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’ · also dat. of possession: ’mine is, I have’ (ἐμοὶ δ’ ὄνομα ’my name is’) · also dat. governed by ὑπό: ’under me’ (ὑπ’ ἐμοὶ δμηθέντα ’subdued under me’)
ἐμῷ: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. sg. · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with κάρητι: ’my own’ · also neut. dat. sg., agreeing with δουρί: ’my’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπίκλησιν: ἐπίκλησις — surname, byname; fem. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by surname’
ἐπεί: ἐπεί — after, since, when; conj. · with κε + subj.: ’whenever, once’
ἐπιπροέηκα: ἐπιπροΐημι — send forth to; aor. 1 sg. act., epic -έηκα (= Attic ἐπιπροῆκα): ’I sent forth’
ἐπισφυρίοις: ἐπισφύριον — ankle-piece, ankle-clasp (of a greave); neut. dat. pl.
ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’) · also + gen., ’toward’ (μελαινάων ἐπὶ νηῶν ’toward the black ships’) · also + gen. of time, ’in the time of’ (ἐπὶ προτέρων ἀνθρώπων ’in the time of earlier men’) · also adv., ’next, after’ (ἐπὶ δὲ πλήξιππον Ὀρέστην ’and next Orestes’) · also adv., ’besides, in addition’ (ἐπὶ δὲ … ὅρκον ὀμοῦμαι ’besides, I shall swear an oath’) · also adv., ’on it, upon it’ (ἐπὶ … ζυγὸν ἦεν ’there was a yoke upon it’) · also + dat. of time: ’for, during’ (ἐπὶ νυκτί ’for the night’) · also + dat., ’over, for’ (ἐπὶ κτεάτεσσι ’over possessions’) · also + gen., ’for’ (ἐπὶ δώρων ’for the gifts’; force uncertain) · also + dat. of place: ’at’ (ἐπὶ τάφρῳ ’at the ditch’) · also ἐπὶ ἶσα, adverbial: ’equally, evenly’ · also + a φιν-form of place: ’on the (right) side’ (ἐπὶ δεξιόφιν ’on the right’)
ἐρήτυον: ἐρητύω — hold back, restrain; impf. 3 pl.: ’were holding back’
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐστεφάνωται: στεφανόω — wreathe, encircle (στέφανος ’crown’); perf. pass. 3 sg.: ’is wreathed round’
ἑκάστη: ἕκαστος — each, each one; fem. nom. sg.
ἑλέσθαι: αἱρέω — take, take up; aor. mid. inf.: ’to take (for oneself)’
ἑτέρηφι: ἕτερος — the other (of two); fem. sg. with the epic suffix -φι, instrumental (= Attic dat. ἑτέρᾳ): ’with the other (hand)’
ἑταῖρος: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. sg.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen. · also preverb in tmesis (ἔκ … ἐρέω = ἐξερέω ’I shall speak out’)
ἔκταν: κτείνω — kill, slay; aor. 3 pl., root aorist ἔκταν (= Attic ἔκτειναν): ’they killed’
ἔν: ἐν — in, among; prep. + dat., accented ἔν before the enclitic τε (ἔν τε ’and among’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis, apart from its verb (ἔν … φῦ = ἐνέφυ) · also accented ἔν before the enclitic γε (ἔν γ’ αὐτοσταδίῃ ’in close combat’)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative adv., ’where’ (ἔνθ’ ἄρα τε φρένες ἔρχαται ’where the midriff is shut’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔξελον: ἐξαιρέω — take out, pick out; aor. 3 pl., epic ἔξελον (= Attic ἐξεῖλον): ’picked out, chose’
ἔξοχον: ἔξοχος — standing out, eminent; adj., masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with τέμενος, + gen. of comparison: ’choice beyond (others)’ · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial, + gen. of comparison: ’above (others)’ (ἔξοχον ἄλλων)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπειτα: ἔπειτα — then, next, after that; adv.
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also ’tilled land, farmland’ (ἔργα νέμοντο ’inhabited the farmlands’)
ἔργον: ἔργον — deed, work, task; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔρνεϊ: ἔρνος — young shoot, sapling; neut. dat. sg., epic -ϊ (= Attic ἔρνει)
ἔρρων: ἔρρω — go wretchedly, go to one’s hurt; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’coming wretchedly’
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔφατ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., augmented, elided (ἔφατ’ = ἔφατο)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’ · also ’kept, guarded’ · also ’drove’ (ἔχον ἵππους ’drove the horses’) · also pres. part. act. neut. nom. sg., agreeing with a neuter subject: ’holding’ · also ’had, sustained’ (πόνον ἔχον ’sustained toil’)
ἕκτορι: Ἕκτωρ — Hector, son of Priam; masc. dat. sg.: ’for Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg., opponent after μάχομαι: ’with Hector’; and after χωρέω: ’to Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. after a verb of anger: ’with Hector’ · also masc. dat. sg. with ὑπό, of those before whom men flee: ’before Hector’
ἕλε: αἱρέω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic εἷλε) · also aor. 3 sg. in battle: ’killed’ (Σχεδίον … ἕλε ’killed Schedius’)
ἕλετο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented (= εἵλετο): ’took (for himself/herself)’
ἕσσε: ἕννυμι — clothe, put clothes on; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ-: ’clothed, put on’
ἠέλιόν: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε, with ὑπό: ’beneath the sun’
ἠελίοιο: ἥλιος — sun; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠελίοιο (= Attic ἡλίου)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with δῶ: ’our (house)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χόλον: ’our (anger)’
ἣν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. acc. sg. · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: whom, which (fem. acc. sg.)
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἥ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); fem. nom. sg., accented ἥ before γε: ’she’ · also fem. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ἥ τε κόμη ’and the hair’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. nom. sg., ’which’ (ἥ τε … πέληται ’which shall be’) · also fem. nom. sg. pronoun, accented ἥ before the enclitic οἱ: ’she’
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’) · also ἦ … ἦ ’either … or’
ἦμαρ: ἦμαρ — day (epic for ἡμέρα); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἰδυίῃσι: οἶδα — know; perf. part. fem. dat. pl., epic ἰδυίῃσι (= Attic εἰδυίαις): ’skilful’
ἰοῦσα: εἶμι — go; pres. part. fem. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱερῷ: ἱερός — sacred, holy; masc. dat. sg., agreeing with δίφρῳ
ἱκάνεις: ἱκάνω — come to, arrive at; pres. 2 sg. act., + acc.: ’you come’
ἱκάνοι: ἱκάνω — come, reach, come upon (= ἱκνέομαι); pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’might come upon’
ἴδηται: εἶδον (aor. of ὁράω) — see; aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’that he may see’ · also aor. subj. mid. 3 sg., in a general relative clause after ὅς κεν: ’whoever sees’
ἴλιον: Ἴλιος — Ilios, Troy; fem. acc. sg.
ἴσασιν: οἶδα — know; perf. 3 pl. (pres. force), ν-movable: ’they know’
ἶσος: ἴσος — equal, like (+ dat.); masc. nom. sg., epic ἶσος
ἷζε: ἵζω — sit down, take one’s seat; impf. 3 sg.: ’sat down’
ὀλύμπῳ: Ὄλυμπος (epic Οὔλυμπος) — Olympus, mountain home of the gods; masc. dat. sg.
ὀνόμαζε: ὀνομάζω — call by name, speak; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ὠνόμαζε); ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε ’spoke out, named’ in tmesis
ὀρώρει: ὄρνυμι — rouse; perf. ὄρωρα intrans. arise; pluperf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’had arisen’
ὁρᾷ: ὁράω — see; pres. subj. 3 sg. (the indic. has the same spelling), with ὄφρ’ ἂν … κεν: ’as long as he sees’ · also pres. indic. 3 sg., after ὄφρα in a temporal clause: ’while he sees’
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (ὃ πάϊς ’the child’) · also masc. nom. sg., ’the one’ set against a genitive ’the other’ (πρὸ ὃ τοῦ ’before the other’)
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄπασσε: ὀπάζω — give, bestow, send along; aor. 3 sg. act., epic -σσ- (= Attic ὤπασε): ’gave’
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that (+ subj.) · also temporal, ’until, while’ · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρα νέμοιτο ’so that he might enjoy’) · also + fut. indic. in a purpose clause: ’so that … will’ (ὄφρα … εἴσεται ’so that … will know’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’) · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. sg., ’who’ (ὅ με … κάκ’ ἔοργε ’who did me wrong’) · also masc. nom. sg. with a noun, article-like (demonstrative): ’the’ (ὅ τ’ ἀεργὸς ἀνήρ ’the idle man’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of thinking: ’that, because’ (τὰ φρονέων ὅ μοι … ’thinking on these things, that to me …’) · also εἰς ὅ κε + pres. subj. of duration: ’as long as’ (εἰς ὅ κ’ ἀϋτμὴ … μένῃ ’as long as breath remains’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction: ’in that, because’ (ὅ σφιν ἀμύνω ’in that I ward off from them’)
ὅπλά: ὅπλον — tool, implement, gear; neut. acc. pl.
ὅππως: ὅππως — how, in what way; epic doubled π (= ὅπως), introducing an indirect question
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσαι: ὅσος — as much as, as many as; relative pron., fem. nom. pl.
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as many as’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when, whenever; temporal conj. · also ὅτε μή + opt., ’unless, except when’ (ὅτε μὴ … ἐμβάλοι ’unless … should throw’)
ὑποδέξομαι: ὑποδέχομαι — receive as a guest, welcome; fut. 1 sg.
ὑπὸ: ὑπό — under, beneath; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ὑπὸ … τάνυσσαν ’stretched under’) · also prep. + acc. of motion: ’to, under’ (ὑπὸ Ἴλιον ἦλθον ’came to Ilios’) · also prep. + dat., ’under, beneath’ (ὑπὸ πλατανίστῳ ’beneath a plane-tree’) · also prep. + dat. with τίκτω, of the father: ’to’ (ὑπὸ Πειριθόῳ τέκετο ’bore to Peirithous’) · also prep. + gen.: ’beneath, from under’ (ὑπὸ στέρνοιο ’beneath the breast’) · also prep. + gen. of cause: ’under (the blast of)’ (ὑπὸ Ζεφύροιο ἰωῆς) · also prep. + dat. of cause, placed after its noun: ’under the weight of’ (καμάτῳ … ὑπό ’from toil’) · also prep. + acc. after ἀλύξας, of escape: ’from under’ (ὑπὸ κῆρας ἀλύξας ’escaping the death-fates’) · also prep. + dat. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Τρώεσσι δαμῆναι ’to be overcome by the Trojans’) · also prep. + φι-form of cause: ’under, by’ (ὑπὸ Πηλεΐδαο βίηφιν ’by the might of Peleus’ son’) · also prep. + acc., of time or condition throughout: ’under’ (ὑπὸ μηνιθμόν ’all the while under the wrath’) · also prep. + gen. of the agent after a passive: ’at the hands of’ (ὑπὸ Πατρόκλοιο δαμῆναι ’to be subdued by Patroclus’)
ὕπαιθα: ὕπαιθα — from beneath, aside; adv., of swerving: ’aside’
ὕπο: ὑπό — under, by; postpositive prep. (anastrophe) + gen.: ’under, at the stroke of’ · also postpositive + gen., ’from under, from’ (κυνῶν ὕπο ’from the dogs’) · also postpositive + dat.: ’beneath’ (τῇ ὕπο ’beneath it’)
ὠκεανοῖο: Ὠκεανός — Ocean, the river encircling the earth; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’) · also correlative ὣς … ὡς, ’so surely … as’ (in a wish like an oath)
ὥς: ὡς — as; so that; accented ὥς before an enclitic, as in ὥς κε ’so that’ (+ subj.) · also ὥς = ὣς, ’so, thus’, accented before an enclitic (ὥς νύ περ ὧδε ’just so, as now’) · also ὥς κε + subj. in an indirect question: ’how’ (πειρᾶν ὥς κε … ’to try how …’) · also ὡς = ὅτι, ’that’, after a verb of knowing (οἶδα … ὥς ’I know that’) · also ὥς τε, accented before the enclitic τε: ’like, as’ (ὥς τ’ ὄϊες ’like sheep’) · also ὥς κέ + opt., in a wish: ’so (may) …’ · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing a wish with ὄφελ’: ’would that’ (ὥς μ’ ὄφελ’ … ’would that … had …’) · also ὥς τε + inf.: ’so as to’ (ὥς τε νέεσθαι ’so as to go home’) · also ὥς before the enclitic μοι, ’as’ (ὥς μοι δοκεῖ ’as it seems to me’) · also ὥς before the enclitic με, introducing an indirect statement after a verb of remembering: ’how’ (ὥς μ’ … ἔρεξεν ’how he treated me’) · also ὥς = ὡς, ’like, as’, accented after its noun (βόες ὥς ’like cattle’) · also ὥς before the enclitic τοι, in a clause after πείθεο: ’as’ (ὥς τοι … θείω ’as I set for you’) · also ὥς accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τίς τε λέων ’like some lion’)
ὧδε: ὧδε — in this place, in this way, thus; adv.
ᾗσιν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= ἑῇσιν) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, fem. dat. pl., epic ᾗσιν (= Attic αἷς): ’in which’
ῥ: ἄρα — then, indeed, so; inferential particle, weak form ῥα, elided (ῥ’ = ῥα)
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
